archetype.title: Archetype
archetype.subtitle: Choose how you will score this run

classic.name: Classic
classic.tagline: Base deck, no bias. The original experience.
classic.how: Play with the full base deck and every card on equal footing. The way to learn the system with nothing pushing you in one direction.
classic.weakness: With no signature element the shop will not help you focus: you lean more on luck.

spores.name: Spores
spores.tagline: Multiply Spores until one hand is everything.
spores.desc: Spores multiply your score: every card you add to the pile is worth more than the last.
spores.how: Gather many Spore cards and trigger the multipliers. The more spores that score in one hand, the bigger the final burst.
spores.weakness: With no multiplier active your hands are worth little. The most fragile archetype early on.

colony.name: Colony
colony.tagline: A stable base that grows turn by turn.
colony.desc: Mycelium doesn't chase the big hit: it stacks solid Substrate and keeps the pace no matter what.
colony.how: Lay down the mycelium network, add permanent Substrate and win by consistency. Every card reinforces the others.
colony.weakness: Low ceiling: against bosses with very high targets you'll lack the damage spike.

decay.name: Decay
decay.desc: You apply Rotting to your own cards, then consume it to harvest Spores. The risk is real: if you don't harvest, decomposition eats your score.
decay.how: Mark cards with Rotting, then play the harvester to turn that status into Spores. The longer you hold out, the bigger the payoff.
decay.weakness: Every rotting card scores LESS while you wait. Hold too long and you lose the hand.

crystal.name: Crystal
crystal.desc: Crystal rewards complete hands: when everything lines up it multiplies hard; when it doesn't, it stays dull.
crystal.how: Chase full, perfect hands to fire high multipliers. You get cheap purges to keep only what works.
crystal.weakness: It depends on consistency: a poor hand has no plan B.

tutorial.startHint: Learn by playing a full Ante (2 challenges + Boss).

blindSelect.title: Pick your first challenge
blindSelect.body: Each Blind asks for a score (the target). You get a limited number of hands and discards. Beat it and you move on.

handDealt.title: Your hand
handDealt.body: These are the cards you drew. Each has an ELEMENT, a FAMILY, and a Substrate and Spore value.

selectCards.title: Select 3 to 5 cards
selectCards.body: Tap cards to pick them (a green border and a number appear). The more you put on the table, the more Substrate you add.

comboHint.title: A combo!
comboHint.body: Sharing a Family or Element triggers a combo: Family cards add flat Substrate, Element cards multiply Spores. The combo closes every hand.

playHand.title: Play the hand
playHand.body: Press PLAY. The cards’ Substrate is multiplied by your Spores, and that’s the hand score.

scoreBreakdown.title: How the score was built
scoreBreakdown.body: The breakdown shows base Substrate, combo bonuses and the Spore multiplier. That’s how you hit (or missed) the target.

rewardDraft.title: Pick a reward
rewardDraft.body: You beat the Blind: choose 1 of the offered cards. It enters your deck right away and you’ll draw it in upcoming Blinds.

shopIntro.title: The shop
shopIntro.body: Spend the Fungi you earned on Symbionts (they give passive effects), cards and upgrades. You can also sell what you no longer use.

purgeIntro.title: Purging the deck
purgeIntro.body: You can remove cards to make the deck more consistent. Careful: you can purge at most 2 cards per Ante.

upgradeIntro.title: Upgrading cards
upgradeIntro.body: Leveling a card multiplies its Substrate or Spores. There is no upgrade cap: a small card can become your best card.

bossIntro.title: The Ante Boss
bossIntro.body: The third Blind is the Boss, with its own rules (fewer hands, higher targets or odd effects). Read them in its panel before entering.

anteComplete.title: Ante complete!
anteComplete.body: You just played a full Ante: that’s how FungiFlush plays. Now go solo — the next Ante asks for a higher score. Good luck!

elementFamily.title: Two axes, two effects
elementFamily.body: ELEMENT (Bloom) multiplies your Spores; FAMILY (Colony) adds Substrate. Same element = Spores; same family = Substrate. They are two different axes and it pays not to overlap them.

discard.title: If the hand is bad, discard

fungiFlush.title: Your ability: FungiFlush
fungiFlush.body: It charges when you play a big combo: 3+ cards of the same element or 4+ of the same family. At 3/3, fire it ONCE per Blind: ×2.5 on your next hand, clears Decay and Spore Lock, and draws 2 cards.

substrateSpores.title: Substrate × Spores
substrateSpores.body: A hand's score is Substrate × Spores. Substrate is ADDED (cards, family, diversity); Spores are MULTIPLIED (element, upgrades). Raise the multiplier and the total skyrockets.

overlapAxes.title: Don't let the deck play for you
overlapAxes.body: Your Bloom and your Colony used the SAME cards, so the Colony paid half. To collect both axes in full, cross them: have a family spread across elements, or an element spread across families.

archetypeBias.title: The shop is biased
archetypeBias.body: Each archetype (Spores, Colony, Decay, Crystal) biases what the shop offers toward its element. This tutorial run uses the classic deck; in your runs you pick an archetype at the start.

diversityBonus.title: Reward for variety
diversityBonus.body: Five different elements in the same hand give +25 Substrate. It's the opposite of overlapping: the more spread out the element, the more you collect.

orderBonus.title: Order scores too
orderBonus.body: If Substrate grows in the order you play, you get Ladder (+18). If you close with the strongest card, you get Crown (×1.25 Spores). Arrange your hand before playing.

chapterBIntro.title: Advanced block: Decay deck
chapterBIntro.body: Now you play a short run with an archetype deck. These cards are NOT in the classic deck: they show you decay, retrigger and symbiotes live.

decayHarvest.title: Decay: from burden to harvest
decayHarvest.body: Decay subtracts Substrate every time a card fires. Harvester cards consume it and turn it into Spores or Substrate. Sow decay and harvest it in the same hand.

retriggerPosition.title: Position and retrigger
retriggerPosition.body: Some cards retrigger the previous or the next one (Echo, Parasite). Placing a powerful card next to a retrigger multiplies its effect: position stops being a detail.

jokerDemo.title: Symbiotes
jokerDemo.body: Symbiotes are passive: they have a trigger and a condition (for example, ×1.5 Spores when you play a Poison card). They chain together: stack the ones that share a condition.

chapterBComplete.title: Tutorial complete
chapterBComplete.body: You've seen FungiFlush's logic: the two axes, crossing them, order, decay and symbiotes. Now go play. Good luck!
